decisions.reason: After two years the gas tariff comparison is still a close-to-core offer with likely low incremental upkeep on the firm's data base, so management would keep the option open despite somewhat lower uncertainty than in 2024.

The regional energy tariff calculator remains strategically tied to the platform and, as a multi-model line, still offers option value even though its limited website prominence raises the risk of later pruning.

The area definition tool builds directly on existing data and process capabilities and likely complements other products, so a medium-sized sector software firm would usually continue it while monitoring adoption.

By 2025 this lightly presented site-specific comparison line has had time to reveal its prospects, and with overlapping tariff products already in the portfolio management would reallocate resources rather than keep a weaker option open.
